name: Wallet Statement of Account
query:
WITH
base AS (
    SELECT l.*
    FROM `tabPurpledove Payment Log` l
    WHERE l.account_number = (SELECT account_number FROM `tabVirtual Wallet` WHERE name = %(wallet)s)
       OR l.source_account_number = (SELECT account_number FROM `tabVirtual Wallet` WHERE name = %(wallet)s)
       OR l.destination_account_number = (SELECT account_number FROM `tabVirtual Wallet` WHERE name = %(wallet)s)
),
picked AS (
    SELECT transaction_reference, event, MIN(creation) AS creation
    FROM base
    GROUP BY transaction_reference, event
),
ev AS (
    SELECT b.*
    FROM base b
    JOIN picked p
      ON b.transaction_reference = p.transaction_reference
     AND b.event = p.event
     AND b.creation = p.creation
),
running AS (
    SELECT
        ev.*,
        CASE WHEN ev.event = 'static_account.transaction.created' THEN ev.amount
             WHEN ev.event = 'transfer.paid' THEN -ev.amount
             ELSE 0 END AS sval,
        (SELECT balance FROM `tabVirtual Wallet` WHERE name = %(wallet)s) AS cur_bal,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ev.event = 'static_account.transaction.created' THEN ev.amount
                 WHEN ev.event = 'transfer.paid' THEN -ev.amount ELSE 0 END)
            OVER (ORDER BY ev.creation, ev.name ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ev.event = 'static_account.transaction.created' THEN ev.amount
                 WHEN ev.event = 'transfer.paid' THEN -ev.amount ELSE 0 END)
            OVER () AS total_net
    FROM ev
)
SELECT
    date_time, description, reference, status, currency, debit, credit, balance
FROM (
    SELECT CONCAT(%(from_date)s, ' 00:00:00') AS date_time,
           CONCAT('Opening Balance as at ', %(from_date)s) AS description,
           '' AS reference,
           '' AS status,
           'NGN' AS currency,
           0 AS debit,
           0 AS credit,
           COALESCE(
               (SELECT (SELECT cur_bal FROM running LIMIT 1)
                       - (SELECT total_net FROM running LIMIT 1)
                       + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sval), 0) FROM running WHERE creation < CONCAT(%(from_date)s, ' 00:00:00'))),
               (SELECT balance FROM `tabVirtual Wallet` WHERE name = %(wallet)s)
           ) AS balance,
           1 AS sort_order
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.creation AS date_time,
           CASE
               WHEN r.event = 'static_account.transaction.created' THEN
                   CONCAT_WS(' - ',
                       CONCAT('Credit from ', COALESCE(r.source_account_name, r.source_account_number, 'Unknown sender'),
                              CASE WHEN r.source_bank_name IS NOT NULL AND r.source_bank_name != '' THEN CONCAT(' (', r.source_bank_name, ')') ELSE '' END),
                               NULLIF(r.narration, ''))
               WHEN r.event = 'transfer.failed' THEN
                   CONCAT_WS(' - ',
                       CONCAT('Failed transfer to ', COALESCE(r.destination_account_name, r.destination_account_number, 'Unknown beneficiary'),
                              CASE WHEN r.destination_bank_name IS NOT NULL AND r.destination_bank_name != '' THEN CONCAT(' (', r.destination_bank_name, ')') ELSE '' END),
                               NULLIF(r.narration, ''))
               ELSE
                   CONCAT_WS(' - ',
                       CONCAT('Transfer to ', COALESCE(r.destination_account_name, r.destination_account_number, 'Unknown beneficiary'),
                              CASE WHEN r.destination_bank_name IS NOT NULL AND r.destination_bank_name != '' THEN CONCAT(' (', r.destination_bank_name, ')') ELSE '' END),
                               NULLIF(r.narration, ''))
           END AS description,
           r.transaction_reference AS reference,
           r.status AS status,
           'NGN' AS currency,
           CASE WHEN r.sval < 0 THEN -r.sval ELSE 0 END AS debit,
           CASE WHEN r.sval > 0 THEN r.sval ELSE 0 END AS credit,
           r.cur_bal + r.cum - r.total_net AS balance,
           2 AS sort_order
    FROM running r
    WHERE DATE(r.creation) BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
    UNION ALL
    SELECT CONCAT(%(to_date)s, ' 23:59:59') AS date_time,
           CONCAT('Closing Balance as at ', %(to_date)s) AS description,
           '' AS reference,
           '' AS status,
           'NGN' AS currency,
           COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.sval < 0 THEN -r.sval ELSE 0 END), 0) AS debit,
           COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.sval > 0 THEN r.sval ELSE 0 END), 0) AS credit,
           (SELECT cur_bal FROM running LIMIT 1) AS balance,
           3 AS sort_order
    FROM running r
    WHERE DATE(r.creation) BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
) t
ORDER BY sort_order, date_time, reference
